target: aarch64-linux-static in disposable one-CPU, 2 GiB Podman VM

observed.cleanup: Observer killed its test child; the dedicated VM was stopped and removed.

scope: One native Linux ARM64 artifact with the pinned compiler/runtime above. The observer waits for the exact test process, kills its guest, and checks the child's command and non-zombie status. It does not test a held lock, resource limit, grandchildren, daemonized work, macOS, latest Amu runtime, or a production governor. It does not establish how long the child would otherwise survive. Python was used only as an isolated test observer, not as an operational component.
